title: Zn2+ Induced Phase Transformation of K2MnFe(CN)6 Boosts Highly Stable Zinc-Ion Storage

nodes.label: Zinc-ion batteries need cathodes holding a high, stable capacity at high voltage over hundreds of cycles

requires_unseen: framing from the title and the F2 linked text; no introduction in the packet

notes: Packet figure ids are offset from the paper's figure numbers from F4 on (packet F4 = paper Figure 5, F5 = Figure 6, F6 = Figure 7, F7 = Figure 8, F8 = Figure 9); paper Figure 4 (XRD and EDS of three electrolytes) has no record in the packet although the F3 linked text describes it, so the electrolyte-control branch (no phase change without Zn2+) is left out of the graph. F2 and F6 offer no panel crops (tiers C1 and C6), so their nodes carry figs with empty panel_ids. Supporting-information readouts (ICP formula, slow-scan XRD S8, direct KZnHCF S9, Mn in separators S11, 4th-cycle coexistence S14, simulated patterns S15) are not in the packet and are marked in requires_unseen. Branches: (1) design/synthesis -> pristine monoclinic KMnHCF; (2) electrolyte choice -> cycling -> composition change; they meet at the conversion to KZnHCF. Redox-centre identification (n17) is the second branch into the capacity claim.
